title: Prepositions of Time: IN, ON, AT
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas el uso de las preposiciones IN, ON, y AT para hablar de fechas y horarios en inglés.

parts.visual: IN (Periodos largos): Meses (in January), Años (in 2023), Estaciones (in summer), Partes del día (in the morning). ON (Días y fechas exactas): Días (on Monday), Fechas (on March 5th), Días especiales (on New Year's Day).
parts.audio: IN is for long periods: Months like in January, years like in 2023, and parts of the day like in the morning. ON is for specific days and dates: on Monday, on March 5th, or on New Year's Day.

parts.visual: AT (Horas y momentos exactos): Horas (at 5:00 PM), Momentos precisos (at noon, at midnight), Fiestas sin la palabra 'day' (at Christmas). EXCEPCIÓN: at night (en la noche).
parts.audio: AT is for exact times: at 5 PM, at noon, or at midnight. Also for holidays without the word 'day', like at Christmas. Remember the exception: at night.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige in, on, o at según corresponda.

questions.question: I usually check my emails ____ the morning.
questions.explanation: Partes del día (morning, afternoon, evening) = in.

questions.question: I have a conference call ____ noon.
I prefer to work ____ night when it's quiet.
We have a big promotion ____ Christmas.
questions.explanation: Fiestas sin la palabra 'day' = at (at Christmas).

questions.question: We don't work ____ Christmas Day.
questions.explanation: Si lleva la palabra 'Day' = on (on Christmas Day).

questions.question: Are you available ____ Friday morning?
questions.explanation: Si mencionas el día (Friday), gana la regla del día = on.

questions.question: The factory closes ____ the weekend. (Inglés británico o general).
questions.explanation: At the weekend (Británico) o On the weekend (Americano). 'At' es común aquí.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la preposición correcta: in, on, at.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We opened the new branch in 2021.
options: We opened the new branch in 2021.
We opened the new branch on 2021.
We opened the new branch at 2021.
We open the new branch in 2021.
questions.correct_answer: We opened the new branch in 2021.

questions.tts_text: Our fiscal year ends in December.

questions.correct_answer: Our fiscal year ends in December.

I check my emails in the morning.
questions.correct_answer: I usually check my emails in the morning.
